dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need help at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Not that I don't want to help you, obviously, but I'm just... a bit swamped at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The Feiyun Commerce Guild's representative just left, and now we need to send people to put up recruitment notices for miners.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: Once we're done here, I'm gonna apply for some leave.
